name: WNBA_R3A2_STRICT_PREFIX_FEATURE_CONSTRUCTOR_CONTRACT_V1

identity_rule.primary_game_identity: Pinned season team-box assets: game_id, game_date, team_id, team_home_away, opponent_team_id.
identity_rule.2020_exception: Pinned schedule master is known to omit game_id 401241311; certified team-box identity is authoritative for 2020.
identity_rule.pair_requirement: Exactly two coherent opponent rows, exactly one HOME and one AWAY, and identical parsed game_date on both sides.

anti_leakage_batch_rule.target_date_rule: For every official date D, construct and seal ALL target-game feature rows from team histories containing only finalized regular-season games with game_date strictly less than D.
anti_leakage_batch_rule.ingestion_rule: Only after every target row for date D is sealed may any completed-game components from date D be appended to team history.

cold_start_rule.target_row_is_emitted_only_if: Both target sides have at least one prior finalized regular-season game in the same season.
cold_start_rule.reason: Every emitted factor requires genuine pregame team history; no league-average or post-hoc imputation is authorized.

frozen_feature_windows.season_to_date: All prior finalized same-season regular-season games.
frozen_feature_windows.recent10: The last at most 10 prior finalized same-season regular-season games ordered by game_date, then game_id for deterministic tie handling.

frozen_aggregation_semantics.reason: Preserves possession/attempt weighting and avoids treating low-volume and high-volume games as equal percentage observations.

determinism.row_order: season ascending, gameDate ascending, gameId ascending
determinism.serialization: Canonical compact JSON per row with sorted object keys, newline-delimited UTF-8.

required_evidence: Frozen asset size/SHA verification for all 2020-2025 team-box sources.
Per-season emitted prefix row counts and cold-start exclusions.
For every emitted side, maxPriorDate < target gameDate.
All emitted factor values finite and within mathematically valid ranges.
No score, winner, market, injury or manual-adjustment values in the output rowset.
